slides.sub: we track extern postings across Ontario hospitals

facts.claim: Halton Healthcare's Clinical Extern - Nursing posting (REF3367F), posted April 2, 2026, listed 50 positions. Its internal application deadline was April 9, 2026, and the posting has since expired.
Mackenzie Health's Clinical Extern (Nursing) posting 2026-18701 says it is not for an existing vacancy and that the hospital is sourcing candidates for potential future opportunities.
facts.quote: This posting is not for an existing vacancy. We are sourcing candidates for potential future opportunities.

facts.claim: Halton Healthcare's posting listed a salary of $23.45 to $28.79 per hour.
Mackenzie Health's posting lists both the minimum and maximum rate as CAD $22.00 per hour.
Halton Healthcare required a BScN program in 2nd, 3rd or 4th year of study, or a Practical Nursing program in final year of study, and also accepted final year of an accelerated BScN.
facts.value: BScN year 2, 3 or 4, or final-year PN
facts.quote: Baccalaureate Nursing Program (BScN) in 2nd, 3rd or 4th year of study or Practical Nursing Program in final year of study

facts.claim: Mackenzie Health requires enrolment in an RN program and entering 2nd, 3rd or 4th year, or an RPN program and entering final year.
facts.value: RN entering year 2, 3 or 4, or RPN entering final year
facts.quote: Enrolled in a Registered Nursing Program (RN) and entering the 2nd , 3rd or 4th year of the Program or Enrolled in a Registered Practical Nursing Program (RPN) and entering the final year of the Program.

caption.text: same title, very different fine print ✍️ one was a closed posting with 50 positions, the other is a talent pool, not a current vacancy. always read the post category line before you write a cover letter. both postings are on the receipts slide.
